opportunities.name: Plan a city trip (flight + hotel + tour) and log a summary note
opportunities.description: For a destination city and date range, search round-trip flights from Paris on Google Flights, search hotels on Booking.com, find a top tour on Viator, then write a summary note with the prices.
steps: On Google Flights, set origin to Paris and destination to {city}
Open the Departure date picker and choose {depart_date} and {return_date}, then click Done and search
Note the cheapest/best flight airline and price
On Booking.com, enter {city} as destination and select the matching suggestion
Pick {depart_date} as check-in and {return_date} as check-out, then click Search
Open a suitable hotel result and note its name and price
On Viator, search '{attraction} tour {city}' and open the top result ('Likely to Sell Out'); note its title and price
In Notes, create a new note: 'Trip {city} {dates}: flight {airline} {price}, hotel {hotel} {price}, {attraction} tour {city}: {tour title} {price}' and press Enter

instances.values: city=Rome, Dec 3–Dec 7 2026, attraction=Colosseum; flight easyJet €89, hotel Room Roma Nazionale 452, tour €54
city=Barcelona, Jan 20–Jan 24 2027, attraction=Sagrada Familia; flight Vueling-Iberia €113, hotel IBIS BUDGET BARCELONA CENTER €543, tour €54

opportunities.name: Check browser support for a web feature and email a reply
opportunities.description: For a web feature and a browser, look up support on caniuse.com, find the MDN docs page, then draft a reply email to the person who asked giving the minimum supported version and the docs link.
steps: On caniuse.com, clear the search box and type {feature}, press Enter
Read the first supported version for {browser}
On MDN, click 'Search the site', type {feature}, press Enter
Open the matching reference page and copy its URL
In mail, compose: To={recipient_email}, Subject='Re: {feature} in {browser}'
Body: 'Hi {name}, {feature} is supported in {browser} from version {version}. Docs: {mdn_url}'
Send (the user clicked Discard in the recording)

instances.values: feature=CSS container queries; incomplete, only the caniuse lookup was done before the recording ended

opportunities.name: Compare two Python packages on PyPI/GitHub and record the result
opportunities.description: For two package names, look each up on PyPI, open its repository to get the latest version, release date, GitHub stars and license, then save a comparison note.
steps: On PyPI, click the search box, type {package_a}, press Enter
Open the matching result; note the version and release date
Click the Source/Repository link; note the GitHub stars and license
Repeat the three steps above for {package_b}
In Notes, create a new note: '{a} {ver} {date} {stars} stars {license} vs {b} {ver} {date} {stars} stars {license}' and press Enter

instances.values: requests then httpx; partial, with lookups only and no note written

opportunities.name: Google Flights round-trip search from Paris
opportunities.description: Search round-trip flights from Paris to a destination for given departure and return dates on Google Flights.
steps: Click the 'Where to?' field and type {destination}, then select the suggested option
Make sure origin is Paris
Click Departure; move to the right month with Next if needed
Click {depart_day} then {return_day}
Click Done and Search; review the results

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search for a city and dates
opportunities.description: Search hotels on Booking.com for a destination and check-in/check-out dates, then open a candidate hotel.
steps: Click 'Enter destination', select all and type {city}
Select the matching suggestion
Open the date picker; move to the right month
Click the {checkin} and {checkout} dates
Click Search and open a hotel result

instances.values: Barcelona, Jan 20–Jan 24 2027 → IBIS BUDGET BARCELONA CENTER

opportunities.name: Viator tour search
opportunities.description: Search Viator for a tour of an attraction in a city and open the top result.
steps: Click the search box and clear it
Type '{attraction} tour {city}' and press Enter
Open the top result

steps: Click the PyPI search box, select all, type {package}, press Enter
